(async()=>{const r=await __callMcp('control_draftsman',{expectedJobId:__receiptContext.projectId,action:'play'});if(r.active!==true||!r.status)throw Error('Immediate play receipt is stale: '+JSON.stringify(r));return {immediatePlayVerified:true,result:r}})()

(async()=>{const r=await __callMcp('control_draftsman',{expectedJobId:__receiptContext.projectId,action:'exit'});if(r.active!==false||r.status!==null)throw Error('Immediate exit receipt is stale: '+JSON.stringify(r));return {immediateExitVerified:true,result:r}})()

(async()=>{for(const action of ['blueprint','section_cut','dimensions','plan_book','unknown_action']){const r=await __mcpApi.callAssistantTool('control_draftsman',{expectedJobId:__receiptContext.projectId,action},new AbortController().signal);if(!r.isError)throw Error('Unsupported accepted: '+action)}let unknown=false;try{await __mcpApi.callAssistantTool('unknown_tool',{},new AbortController().signal)}catch(e){unknown=/Unknown/.test(String(e))}if(!unknown)throw Error('Unknown tool succeeded');return {unsupportedActionsRejected:true,unknownToolRejected:true}})()
